remarks: Welcome to 5 Stonybrook Road! Located in the highly sought-after Cranbury neighborhood of Norwalk. This stunning 3 bedroom, 2 1/2 bath ranch has exceptional one-level living with a bright open floor plan. Step into the sun-filled living area, with elegant sliding doors leading to the freshly painted deck. A fully finished basement area provides extra space for an office or exercise room and recreational space. Conveniently located between the Merritt and I95, with proximity to shopping, parks, schools, and major transportation, this home has it all! Move in ready, immaculate condition.
